museum.title: USSS
museum.subtitle: A MUSEUM OF US
museum.dedication: To the one who turned ordinary days into my favourite memories. Every room in this museum holds a piece of us. Walk slowly, look closely, and know that I built all of it for you.

memories.title: The First Hello
memories.caption: Where it all began
memories.message: I still remember how nervous I was. You laughed at my terrible joke and I decided right then that I wanted to hear that laugh forever.

memories.title: Our First Date
memories.caption: Coffee that lasted five hours
memories.message: We ordered one coffee each and stayed until they stacked the chairs. I walked home smiling the whole way.

memories.title: The Rainy Walk
memories.caption: No umbrella, no regrets
memories.message: We got completely soaked and you said it was the best day of the summer. You were right.

memories.title: Our First Road Trip
memories.caption: Wrong turns, right person
memories.message: Six hours of terrible playlists and singing too loud. Getting lost with you is better than arriving anywhere with anyone else.

memories.title: Your Birthday
memories.caption: The cake that almost made it
memories.message: The candles kept going out and we kept relighting them. You made the same wish three times. I hope it was about us.

memories.title: Festival of Lights
memories.caption: Midnight, together
memories.message: Fireworks everywhere and I only looked at you. Best way to start a year.

memories.title: Above the Clouds
memories.caption: Worth every step
memories.message: You held my hand on the steepest part even though you were just as tired. That is exactly who you are.

memories.title: An Ordinary Sunday
memories.caption: My favourite kind of day
memories.message: Nothing special happened, and that is why I love it. Slow mornings with you are my favourite place.

timeline.title: We Met
timeline.message: A normal Tuesday that quietly became the most important day of my life.

timeline.title: It Became Official
timeline.message: I asked you on a bench by the river. You said yes before I even finished the question.

timeline.title: First Trip Together
timeline.message: We learned that we travel well together, even when the bus is four hours late.

timeline.title: "I Love You"
timeline.milestone: Said out loud for the first time
timeline.message: I had practised it a hundred times. It still came out shaky. You said it back immediately.

timeline.title: One Year
timeline.message: A whole year, and it still feels like it just started.

timeline.title: Right Now
timeline.message: This moment counts too. Every day with you gets a place on this timeline.

paragraphs: If you are reading this, you have walked through every frame of the Memory Hall. I hope you smiled at least once.
I wanted to make you something that you could walk around in, because the way you make me feel is not something that fits on a card. It needs rooms. It needs light. It needs space to breathe.
Thank you for every ordinary day you made extraordinary, for every time you listened, and for every time you stayed.
There is more ahead. Keep walking.

framedNote.title: The First Note
framedNote.caption: The first note I ever wrote you
framedNote.message: I wrote this on a napkin and was too shy to give it to you for a week. I kept it all this time.

finale.heading: The Last Room Was Always You
paragraphs: Every frame, every letter and every date in this museum leads here.
I do not know what the future looks like, but I know who I want in every room of it.
Thank you for being my favourite memory, and my favourite person to make new ones with.

gift.title: A Small Gift
gift.message: It is not the box that matters. It is that I thought of you when I saw it, and that I think of you most of the time. Happy everyday, my love.
